about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Full-stack PM × designer's eye
about.status: Open to AI PM / Product roles · 2026 Cohort
about.bio1: I'm 25, based in Hohhot, open to relocation. UQ MSc Interaction Design under the School of Computer Science (Group of Eight, QS Top 50), Nankai BA Marketing — a deliberately T-shaped path through the technical, design, and business sides of shipping product.
about.bio2: What I actually do well: take a product from 0 to 1, solo. The chemical-trade sales dashboard you'll see below is the cleanest proof — a 7-day sprint from user research → architecture → React/Node/PostgreSQL full-stack → live in production. I define the spec, write the code, talk to the users. That's the loop I'm best at.
about.bio3: Today I live at the frontier of AI tooling — daily-driving Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, and OpenClaw (self-configured with 104 Skills across 7 domains). I benchmark Claude / GPT / Gemini / MiniMax / DeepSeek into real production decisions, and I've watched the AI product arc go from chat → coding → agent → ecosystem firsthand. My belief: the best AI PMs are also AI builders.
